productname: Annie Chocolate Velvet Barrel Chair w/Casters
productdescription: Meet the Annie Velvet Barrel Chair in cotton color, where style meets everyday ease. Designed with sleek tuxedo arms and a smooth, curved silhouette, it brings a modern, tailored look to any space. Four independent casters make it easy to move wherever you need extra seating. Wrapped in soft cotton-colored velvet, it feels incredibly luxurious to the touch, while the 100% polyester fabric keeps it durable and easy to care for-perfect for real life without sacrificing comfort or sophistication.
techspecs:
* Crafted of 100% polyester fabric in ivory color, pine and poplar solids, engineered wood and foam
* Chair is solidly constructed to support up to 275 pounds in weight
* Five independently rotating casters on each leg offer effortless mobility for smooth and easy movement
* The chair's soft-touch ivory fabric, crafted from 100% polyester ensures plush comfort and a luxurious dining experience, exceptional protection, fade-resistance, and easy maintenance for long-lasting beauty and convenience
* Versatile side chair suitable for dining, office, or living areas, serving as a stylish accent piece
* Cleaning Code SW: Spot clean using a small amount of mild dish soap mixed with water. Gently blot the area with a clean, soft cloth-do not saturate. Allow to air dry.
* Available in gray, brown and white fabric

productdescription: The Conroe Dual-Power Recliner in Cobblestone blends modern style with personalized comfort in a streamlined silhouette. Upholstered in a light tan Cobblestone fabric, it offers a warm, versatile look that fits easily into a variety of spaces. Discreet inner-arm controls allow you to independently adjust the power headrest and footrest for a fully customized lounging experience. Built with a 100% polyester cover, a durable furniture-grade plywood frame, and supportive sinuous wire springs, this recliner is designed for lasting comfort and everyday use.
techspecs:
* Crafted of solid Asian hardwoods, engineered woods, foam and 100% polyester cover
* Dual-power reclining allows you to customize your comfort with independent headrest and footrest controls, plus a convenient home button to reset the seat, located conveniently in-between seats
* Sinuous Spring construction ensures even weight distribution, preventing the formation of sagging spots for consistent support for all seats.
* 100% Kiln Dried Furniture-Grade Plywood frame
* Fiber filled back provides contoured support, enhanced relaxation and resilience in an allergy-friendly fill
* 2.0 Density Foam (in seat cushions) - Inner Bagged & Baffled Fiber Fill to retain shape in seat backs
* Durable 100% polyester cover resists wear, stains, and wrinkles while maintaining a soft, comfortable feel for everyday use.
* 360 lb. weight capacity ensures durability and reliable support.
* Available in Cobblestone or Gray for the Cobblestone Sectional or Gray Sectional.
